description: Read the WORK-BUDGET VOTE. With no id, the proposals the house has published, newest first, each with its status (not open, open or closed) and its question. With proposalId, one proposal in full: its question, its options with the count for each, when it opens and closes, the hash a ballot names, and the authority boundary that says the vote is advisory and nonbinding. Only counts are shown: never a wallet, never a ballot. The program is held off until the operator switches the NET programs on together, and until then the read says so plainly; this tool moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through it. Free, keyless, nothing to sign. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.
